sources.title: HOMETOWN HEALTH: Babies born to mothers exposed to wildfire smoke, air pollution more likely to develop asthma, research finds
Rare salamanders spotted in Table Rock Watershed after Helene, wildfire

en.title: Mothers exposed to wildfire smoke more likely to have children with asthma, research finds
en.dek: WDBJ7 reports link between maternal exposure and increased asthma risk in children
facts: WDBJ7 reported research finding that babies born to mothers exposed to wildfire smoke and air pollution are more likely to develop asthma
FOX Carolina News reported rare salamanders spotted in Table Rock Watershed after Hurricane Helene and wildfire activity
Both stories were published by the outlets on November 13, 2026
body: WDBJ7 reported research finding that babies born to mothers exposed to wildfire smoke and air pollution are more likely to develop asthma.
The study examined the relationship between maternal exposure and respiratory outcomes in children, as reported by the outlet.
FOX Carolina News reported that rare salamanders were spotted in the Table Rock Watershed following Hurricane Helene and wildfire activity.
The news outlet noted the animals' presence after the storm and fire events.
en.context: Two separate news stories published on the same date covered distinct topics: early-life health impacts from air quality and wildlife observations in a watershed affected by severe weather.

fr.title: Les mères exposées à la fumée des feux de forêt plus susceptibles d'avoir des enfants asthmatiques, selon une étude
fr.dek: WDBJ7 rapporte un lien entre l'exposition maternelle et un risque accru d'asthme chez les enfants
facts: WDBJ7 a rapporté une étude indiquant que les nourrissons nés de mères exposées à la fumée des feux de forêt et à la pollution atmosphérique sont plus susceptibles de développer de l'asthme
FOX Carolina News a signalé l'observation de rares salamandres dans le bassin versant de Table Rock après l'ouragan Helene et l'activité des feux de forêt
Les deux reportages ont été publiés par ces médias le 13 novembre 2026
body: WDBJ7 a rapporté des recherches indiquant que les nourrissons nés de mères exposées à la fumée des feux de forêt et à la pollution atmosphérique sont plus susceptibles de développer de l'asthme.
L'étude a examiné le lien entre l'exposition maternelle et les résultats respiratoires chez les enfants, selon ce média.
FOX Carolina News a signalé l'observation de salamandres rares dans le bassin versant de Table Rock suite à l'ouragan Helene et aux activités liées aux feux de forêt.
Le média a noté la présence de ces animaux après les événements de tempête et d'incendie.
fr.context: Deux reportages distincts publiés à la même date couvraient des sujets différents : les impacts sur la santé précoce liés à la qualité de l'air et les observations de la faune dans un bassin versant affecté par des conditions météorologiques sévères.

es.title: Madres expuestas al humo de incendios forestales tienen más probabilidades de tener hijos con asma, según investigación
es.dek: WDBJ7 informa sobre la relación entre la exposición materna y el aumento del riesgo de asma en niños
facts: WDBJ7 informó de un estudio que vincula el nacimiento de bebés a madres expuestas al humo de incendios forestales y contaminación del aire con una mayor probabilidad de desarrollar asma
FOX Carolina News informó de la detección de salamandras raras en la cuenca hidrográfica de Table Rock tras el huracán Helene y la actividad de incendios forestales
Ambas noticias fueron publicadas por los medios el 13 de noviembre de 2026
body: WDBJ7 informó de una investigación que revela que los bebés nacidos de madres expuestas al humo de incendios forestales y a la contaminación atmosférica tienen más probabilidades de desarrollar asma.
El estudio examinó la relación entre la exposición materna y los resultados respiratorios en los niños, según informó el medio.
FOX Carolina News reportó que se avistaron salamandras raras en la cuenca de Table Rock tras el huracán Helene y la actividad de incendios forestales.
El medio notó la presencia de los animales después de los eventos de la tormenta y el incendio.
es.context: Dos noticias distintas publicadas en la misma fecha cubrieron temas diferentes: los impactos en la salud en la primera infancia por la calidad del aire y las observaciones de fauna en una cuenca hidrográfica afectada por clima severo.

ko.title: 연구진, 산불 연기 노출 임산부가 아이에게 천식 위험 높인다는 사실 확인
ko.dek: WDBJ7, 산불 연기·대기오염 산모 아이 천식 위험 연관성 보도
facts: 연구진이 임신부 산불 연기·대기오염 노출 시 아이 천식 발생 위험이 높아진다는 사실을 확인했으며
FOX Carolina News가 허리케인 헬렌과 산불 활동 이후 테이블록 수계에서 희귀 도롱뇽 목격 보도했으며
body: 연구진이 산불 연기 및 대기 오염에 노출된 임산부가 아이를 낳았을 때 아이가 천식에 걸릴 위험이 높다는 사실을 확인했습니다.
해당 연구는 산모의 노출과 어린이 호흡기 결과 사이의 관계를 조사한 것으로, 매체가 보도했습니다.
FOX Carolina News는 헬렌 허리케인과 산불 활동 이후 Table Rock Watershed에서 희귀한 도롱뇽이 목격됐다고 보도했습니다.
해당 매체는 폭풍과 화재 사건 이후 동물들의 존재를 지적했습니다.
ko.context: 두 별도 보도는 대기 질 문제로 인한 영아기 건강 영향과 악천후로 영향을 받은 수계 야생동물 관찰이라는 주제로 이날 동시에 게재된 distinct articles임

problemsFixed: Facts 4 and 5 are unsupported — the sources do not state that both events occurred on the same date, nor do they confirm the salamander sightings were caused by the same wildfire activity mentioned in the health study. Fact 4 repeats the date from Fact 2 without new information. Fact 5 invents a causal link not in the sources.
Body paragraph 3 ends with an evaluative summary ('noting the animals' presence after the storm and fire events') which violates rule 12.
Body paragraph 2 contains vague language ('adds to growing evidence', 'relationship between maternal exposure') unsupported by the source text.
Headline is generic and does not attribute the claim to the outlet or study as required by rules 2 and 8.
The dek uses 'according to recent research' without naming the outlet or study, violating rule 2.
Paragraph 1 repeats the same opening structure as the previous paragraph in the draft (not a structural issue in isolation but contributes to repetitive prose).
Context section contains vague claims ('subjects of ongoing research') not directly supported by the source texts.
